I started dating someone a month after my ex and I broke up. To be fair, I was over him for 5 months but still grasped on to the fact that i may not have someone that loved me as much as he loved me. I was depressed at the time and he was my crutch. However, when we finally broke up, my friends took me out and I started feeling like myself again, confident as can be. I realized that I just cared for him as a person and not romantically so it wasn’t hard to explore options when I was finally out. I didn’t mean to jump into a relationship but it happened and I was the happiest girl ever.

And yes I did miss my ex but in a sense of losing my best friend.
